### 🎙️ Flagship Project: [Rheo](https://github.com/MasterZ1311/Rheo)

> **Sovereign Local-First AI Voice Studio & Neural Cloning Engine**

- **Privacy-First Zero-Shot Voice Cloning**: Generates speech across 23 languages and 7 neural TTS engines without any external network calls.
- **Zero-Latency Global Dictation**: System-wide push-to-talk auto-paste into focused fields with Whisper STT and local LLM refinement.
- **FastMCP Agent Protocol**: Built-in Model Context Protocol server letting Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf converse in your cloned voices.
- **Hardware Acceleration**: Universal hardware support across NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Silicon (Metal/MLX), and Intel Arc.
